forms.detail: AIHW names methylphenidate (Ritalin, Concerta) among pharmaceutical stimulants (Australia); the DEA 'Stimulants' fact sheet names Concerta and Ritalin (United States).
The WHO ATC index lists dexmethylphenidate (N06BA11) and 'dexmethylphenidate and serdexmethylphenidate' (N06BA15) beside methylphenidate (N06BA04).
